Okay this is an easy one. Get a quarter and push it on top of your bump or bite right in the middle and make an indentation. Then, righ on the axis of the indentation make a perpendicular mark on it, making a X or + sign. Sounds weird, I know, but it's worked for me for years. Alaska is full of the biggest mosquitoes around and this has always helped. If your a guitarist, guitar pics work really well, too. If it still itches I just say "fuck it" and then hit it with the rough side of Velcro. Trust me, you've never scratched an itch so good like velcro can do.
